meta.title: Kettlebell block
meta.purpose: Two strength sessions per week to build hinge power and trunk/unilateral stability alongside running
meta.format: Straight sets and reps. No EMOM/Tabata/AMRAP.
meta.equipment: One 16 kg kettlebell (12 kg for overhead work if available). 20 kg only in weeks 7-8, and only if owned.
meta.training_days_note: To be filled in. Sessions go on easy days, never the day before a quality session or race.
meta.start_note: Phase 1 (technique) is complete. Race week is light activation only, at least 48 h before the Oct 4 half marathon. Phase 2 starts once legs feel normal after the race.

stop_and_reassess: Lower back pain (not soreness) after swings
Knee pain in the goblet squat
Running feels flat for more than two consecutive weeks
Get-up feels unstable rather than just unfamiliar: drop back to the half get-up
rules.progression: Change one or two things at a time. Only move to the next phase when the current one feels clean.

swing.name: Two-hand swing
swing.cue: Hinge, not squat. The bell floats from the hip snap, not the arms. Shins vertical, back flat. Feel it in glutes and hamstrings; stop if you feel it in lower back or shoulders.

goblet-squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet-squat.cue: Bell at chest, chest up, elbows inside knees, heels down.

suitcase-carry.name: Suitcase carry
suitcase-carry.cue: Stay stacked, don't lean away from the bell. If you lean, it's too heavy.

half-get-up.name: Half get-up
half-get-up.cue: Slow and deliberate. Stop at the elbow/hand prop, no overhead lunge yet.

full-get-up.name: Full Turkish get-up
full-get-up.cue: Roll to elbow, to hand, sweep the leg through, stand, then reverse exactly the same way. Only when the half get-up is clean.

single-leg-rdl.name: Single-leg RDL
single-leg-rdl.cue: Hips square, standing leg soft, hinge forward as the trailing leg extends back.

racked-carry.name: Racked carry
racked-carry.cue: Bell at shoulder, elbow tucked, ribs down. Don't lean toward the loaded side.

single-arm-row.name: Single-arm row
single-arm-row.cue: Flat back, pull the elbow past the ribs, no torso rotation to help the pull.

side-plank.name: Side plank
side-plank.cue: Straight line from ankle to shoulder, hips lifted, not sagging.

phases.label: Race week (Sep 28 - Oct 4)
phases.note: Optional light activation only, at least 48 h before the Oct 4 half marathon. Skip it if legs feel heavy.

phases.label: Weeks 3-4: full volume (revised)
phases.note: Start once legs feel normal after the race. Two small changes vs the original plan: swings 5x12 and a 2 s pause in the goblet squat.

phases.label: Weeks 5-6: progression
phases.note: Full get-up replaces the half get-up only if the half get-up is clean.

phases.label: Weeks 7-8: heavier
phases.load: 16 kg, 20 kg for swings if owned
phases.note: Swings move to 5x10 at 20 kg (stay at 16 kg if you don't have one). Goblet squat 3x10. Everything else holds from weeks 5-6. Then reassess: add a third day or drop to one maintenance session a week.
